bios.label: One-liner
bios.text: Joe Hart is a product engineer and comedian who makes joyous, charming and occasionally useless things for the web.

bios.label: Short bio
bios.text: Joe Hart is a product engineer and comedian who loves making joyous and charming things. Joe has built front-ends at Monzo, the BBC and LEGO, and spends spare time rebuilding classic video games in tools that were never meant for them.
